verdict.rationale: Khoj's core function is AI chat grounded in the user's own files and notes. It shows the reference notes behind each answer, offers a /notes mode that answers only from the user's notes, and can generate and run Python to analyze data and produce plots and reports. Suggestion-style features include finding similar notes, and scheduled automations email research results. A community user praised the Obsidian integration, but others report weak results with non-English notes and with small local models. Missing for 10: documented proactive or unprompted suggestions beyond scheduled automations and similar-note discovery, and independent hands-on evidence of insight quality across languages and local models.
